module: processors/rs.content_meta.ps1 — colonel chain processor; attaches the ContentMeta element to the entry bag
$comment: PRODUCER declaration for the ContentMeta element. assemble.contract.json leaves entry elements open by design (every non-core bag field rides into the IR in arrival order), so the shape of this element is declared here, by its producer, and nowhere else — this is the source of truth that container.spec.jsonc content_meta sub-field $refs resolve into (#/out/ContentMeta/<Field>). In-memory names are PascalCase; wire names (snake_case) live in the container spec. BYTE SEMANTICS: metrics deal in the content as read; SpanBytes is the UTF-8 byte count of that content and is deliberately NOT a psr sub-field — content_bytes is the same quantity as the container measures it post-codec at write time (one fact, one column). Adding a metric = add it here + in the processor; admitting it on the wire = add a sub-field in the container spec; no writer change.

Content.note: string; absent/null → element still attached with zero metrics

SpanBytes.note: UTF-8 byte count of Content as read (0 when empty). Not a wire sub-field — see $comment

PunctuationCount.note: count, not ratio — no PunctuationRatio is emitted; add it here first if the wire wants one

UniqueChars.note: distinct characters; emitted, currently not admitted on the wire (sub-field removed 2026-08-18, re-admissible)

Entropy.note: Shannon entropy over characters, rounded to Config.Digits

CompressionRatio.note: gzip Fastest length / UTF-8 byte length, rounded to Config.Digits; computed only for content > 100 chars, else 1.0 (deliberate non-parity with the LTS defect that always reported 0). Kolmogorov proxy — tests pin the gate and that repetitive content compresses, not a ratio. Not admitted on the wire until the metric is trusted

WhitespaceRatio.note: whitespace chars / CharCount, rounded to Config.Digits; 0.0 when CharCount is 0

Mean.note: mean line length in characters, rounded to Config.Digits

StdDev.note: population standard deviation of line length, rounded to Config.Digits
